FB501/502 sleevesHF+ and Würth touch/cable ferrites are mechanical common-mode suppression around complete cable, not series electrical inductors. Maintain shielded short cables and retest RFnoise.

All IC physical pins are listed. Bare-IC EN/FAULT/ILIM electrical types retained; caps, pulls and current-setting resistors explicitly drawn. ERC pass alone does not verify power budgets, SI, USB compliance, module internals or thermal behavior.
E4 NT401 owns the single explicit GND/CHASSIS bond; E5 does not add another. E3 owns IMU MCU/BNO085 and consumes E5_IMU_VIN; no duplicate IMU functional module here.
Existing SY7120/SGM40666AS and MKEY supply not rebuilt on this sheet. Q6A 40pin connector owned by E3.
